scope: Fourteen frozen bounded engineering tasks; exact answers are a scoped quality gate, not human preference or general correctness. Includes all eight previously retained service tasks.

tasks.prompt: Records: Ada, paid, 8 units; Ben, unpaid, 12 units; Cy, paid, 5 units. Sum only paid units. Reply with only the number.
From this record: item=lantern; count=7. Return only JSON with keys item and count. count must be a number.
Report: The delivery reached the depot on Tuesday. No destination address is recorded. What street was it delivered to? If the report does not say, reply with exactly UNKNOWN.
Order log in chronological order: quantity 8; corrected quantity 11; final corrected quantity 6. What is the final quantity? Reply with only the number.
Choose exactly one device. Requirements: at least 32 GB RAM and price at most 900. A: 16 GB, 500. B: 32 GB, 850. C: 48 GB, 1100. Reply only with its letter.
Python code: values = [2, 5, 8]; result = sum(x * 2 for x in values if x > 3). What is result? Reply with only the number.
Sort these integers numerically in ascending order: 14, -3, 2, 0. Return only a JSON array of numbers.
Copy exactly the text between the brackets, preserving every character and adding nothing: [café — 東京]
What is 17 + 25? Reply with only the number.

Choose from these fictional movies: Cedar, a calm comedy lasting 84 minutes; Harbor, a tense thriller lasting 91 minutes; Orbit, a calm comedy lasting 122 minutes. We want a calm comedy under 100 minutes. Reply with only the title.
Reply with exactly these three lowercase words, separated by single spaces, without punctuation: copper silver gold
The parcel label says blue: 16, green: 25, red: 31. What number belongs to green? Reply with only the number.
Count the even integers in this list: 3, 4, 7, 10, 12. Reply with only the count.
Reply with the first item that is not a fruit in this list: apple, pear, hammer, orange. Reply with only that item.
